title: Ridgecrest Advantage Benefit Schedule Extract: Office, Urgent, Emergency, Laboratory and Ambulance Cost Share
content:
The member copay for each of the following service categories under the Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plans is fixed by the plan held, in USD.

| Plan | In-network primary care visit | In-network specialist visit | Urgent care centre visit | Emergency department visit | In-network clinical laboratory services | One-way ground ambulance trip |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Value (HMO) | 0 | 35 | 30 | 110 | 0 | 275 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Essential (HMO) | 0 | 40 | 35 | 120 | 0 | 285 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Plus (HMO-POS) | 5 | 45 | 40 | 135 | 10 | 300 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Premier (PPO) | 10 | 45 | 45 | 145 | 15 | 325 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Signature (PPO) | 15 | 50 | 50 | 150 | 20 | 350 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO) | 0 | 30 | 25 | 95 | 0 | 225 |

Every figure in this extract is a copay in USD for one visit, one course of laboratory services or one one-way ground ambulance trip. The emergency department copay is waived where the visit leads to an inpatient admission.

### Basis questions

**On which plans does a member meet nothing for an in-network primary care visit?** On Ridgecrest Advantage Value (HMO), Ridgecrest Advantage Essential (HMO) and Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO), where the figure is 0 USD. On the remaining three the figure is 5, 10 and 15 USD respectively.

**Which plan carries the lowest figures in this extract?** Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO), at 0 USD for primary care, 30 USD for a specialist, 25 USD for urgent care, 95 USD for an emergency department visit, 0 USD for laboratory services and 225 USD for a ground ambulance trip.

**Does the specialist figure ever match the urgent care figure?** On Ridgecrest Advantage Premier (PPO) both stand at 45 USD, and on Ridgecrest Advantage Signature (PPO) both stand at 50 USD. On the other four plans the specialist figure stands above the urgent care figure.
